program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (21.0, 17.0, 25.0),
    "L1":    (2.5, 1.5, 3.5),
    "ktail": (1.4, 1.1, 2.0),
    "I6":    (75e-6, 50e-6, 100e-6),
    "gmid3": (10.0, 8.0, 13.0),
    "L3":    (1.5, 1.0, 3.0),
    "gmidT": (19.0, 14.0, 22.0),
    "LT":    (3.0, 1.5, 4.0),
    "Cc":    (5.0e-12, 3.5e-12, 7e-12),
    "rzk":   (1.2, 0.8, 2.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    itail = p["ktail"] * iref
    i1 = itail / 2
    I6 = p["I6"]; Cc = p["Cc"]

    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidT"], p["LT"], iref, vds=0.5)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidT"], p["LT"], itail, vds=0.25)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmidT"], p["LT"], I6, vds=0.9)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.5, vsb=0.25)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], i1, vds=1.0)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I6, vds=0.9)

    Rz = p["rzk"] * (Cc + cl) / (m6.gm * Cc)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "xd", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "xd", "xd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x1", "xd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "x1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "vout", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "x1", Cc)

    A1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain = db(A1 * A2)
    gbw = 1.3 * m1.gm / (2 * PI * Cc)          # empirical 1.3x seen in sim
    c2 = cl + m6.cdd + m7.cdd
    c1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd + 2 * m1.cgd
    p2 = m6.gm * Cc / (2 * PI * (c2 * Cc + c2 * c1 + Cc * c1))
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd + m1.cgd + m3.cdd))
    fz = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * max(Rz - 1.0 / m6.gm, 1e-3))
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / fz)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / pmir)) + math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / (2 * pmir)))
    pm = min(pm, 89.0)
    slew = min(itail / Cc, I6 / (cl + Cc)) * 0.6
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * gbw / 1.3)
    settle = 0.5 / slew + 4.6 * tau
    power = 1.98 * (iref + itail + I6)
    vtail = 0.81 - (m1.vgs + 0.12)
    cmrr = db(A1 * 2 * m3.gm / mt.gds) - 3
    if vtail < mt.vdsat + 0.05:
        cmrr -= 15
    psrr = cmrr - 3
    swing = vdd - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.15
    ref = lut.size("n", 16.0, 1.0, 4.8e-6, vds=0.6)
    a0 = ref.W * ref.L
    vn_in = 648e-9 * math.sqrt(a0 / (m1.W * m1.L))
    vn_ld = 648e-9 * math.sqrt(a0 / (m3.W * m3.L)) * (m3.gm / m1.gm)
    noise = math.sqrt(vn_in**2 + vn_ld**2) * 0.5 * 1.35   # calibrated (sim/pred ~0.41) + hot corner
    return n, {"gain_db": gain, "ugbw": gbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew, "settle": settle,
               "power": power, "cmrr_db": cmrr, "psrr_db": psrr, "swing": swing,
               "noise_1k": noise, "vos": 2e-4}
